senses.gloss: m. (דפף, to hammer, join; cmp. דפן) board, plank; trnsf. a column in the scroll (later Hebr. a leaf of a book).
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 15:2">Kel. XV, 2</cite> <he>ד׳ של נחתומות וכ׳</he> the (metal) plank of the bakers joined to the wall; <cite ref="Bava Batra 66a:5">B. Bath. 66ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Batra 66b">66ᵇ</cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Yadayim 4:8">Yad. IV, 8</cite> <he>בד׳</he> on the same column. Tosef. Gitt. IX (VII), 10; a. fr.—Pl. <he>דַּפִּים</he>, <he>דַּפִּין</he>.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 75a">Ab. Zar. 75ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Niddah 65a">Nidd. 65ᵃ</cite> <he>הד׳</he> the planks used as frame in the wine press.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 14">Num. R. s. 14</cite> (ed. Amst. p. 258ᶜ) <he>מקיים הד׳</he> keeps the joined boards (of the door) together.
<cite ref="Menachot 30a:11">Men. 30ᵃ</cite> (<cite ref="J00638"><he>יריעה</he></cite>) <he>בת שלש ד׳</he> a sheet of parchment wide enough for three columns.
<cite ref="Menachot 30b:1">Ib.ᵇ</cite> <he>לבין הד׳</he> in the space between the columns.
<cite ref="Mishnah Negaim 11:9">Neg. XI, 9</cite> <he>דַּפֵּי חלוק</he> the strips (widths) of a shirt; a. fr.
